# [ROCm] Support ROCm 7.15 on MI300/MI325

## Summary
- The previous images and `amd_tutorial` docs no longer support proper model training; they have been updated to better align with the ROCm ecosystem.
- Rebuild the ROCm image on `rocm/primus:v26.5` so MI300/MI325 (gfx942) tracks the CUDA image's SGLang v0.5.21 and Megatron-LM `core_v0.19.2` stack. slime is cloned from THUDM/slime main at build time.
- Align both language tutorials with the existing Qwen3-4B AMD recipe (`Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`), and clear the Primus attention-backend overrides that conflict with `--attention-backend`.

## Changes

- Replace `docker/Dockerfile.rocm`. The image starts from `rocm/primus:v26.5` and keeps that image's torch, triton, aiter, flash-attn, and Transformer Engine. It clones THUDM/slime main, installs SGLang v0.5.21 (`e00930c`) with the `docker/patch/v0.5.21` patch stack from that clone, builds `sgl-kernel` through `setup_rocm.py`, builds `torch_memory_saver` for HIP, and installs Megatron-LM `core_v0.19.2` (`4b4acac9`). The default GPU target is gfx942.
- Pin runtime library and device settings in the image: `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` follows the copies torch and Transformer Engine load, `GPU_ARCHS` is the build target, and `RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1`. An entrypoint unsets `NVTE_FLASH_ATTN`, `NVTE_FUSED_ATTN`, and `NVTE_UNFUSED_ATTN` so every `docker run` process drops the Primus presets. Transformer Engine reads these with `int(os.getenv(...))`, so the variables have to be absent.
- In `scripts/run-qwen3-4B-amd.sh`, unset the same three `NVTE_*` variables before launch. The recipe uses `--rm-type dapo` with `--reward-key score`, 8192-token rollout and eval responses, `--num-rollout 100`, `--eval-interval 10`, and `--skip-eval-before-train`. The checkpoint stays `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`.
- Rewrite `docs/en/platform_support/amd_tutorial.md` and `docs/zh/platform_support/amd_tutorial.md` to build or pull `amdagi/slime:rocm7.15_torch2.12_py3.12`, download `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`, and run the same conversion and training commands. Conversion still passes `--use-cpu-initialization`. The `NVTE_*` unset is not in the conversion snippet; the image entrypoint clears those variables.

+# slime (THUDM) + SGLang v0.5.21 + Megatron-LM core_v0.19.2 on ROCm, FROM the locked rocm/primus:v26.5.
+#
+# Mirrors slime docker/Dockerfile (the CUDA baseline): same SGLang tag, Megatron commit and
+# sgl-router fork wheel. slime is cloned from THUDM/slime main at build time, and the
+# docker/patch/v0.5.21 patches are applied from that clone rather than from the build context.
+# ROCm differences: torch, triton, aiter, flash-attn and Transformer Engine come from the base image
+# unchanged; sgl-kernel is built from SGLang's AOT sources with setup_rocm.py; torch_memory_saver is
+# built for HIP.
+FROM rocm/primus:v26.5
+
+ARG SGLANG_TAG=v0.5.21
+ARG SGLANG_COMMIT=e00930c5489053f26d86b179cee0d087f846acbb
+ARG MEGATRON_TAG=core_v0.19.2
+ARG MEGATRON_COMMIT=4b4acac9a1d28ea6829c8d4f566d75698a21249d
+ARG TMS_COMMIT=118b09b3bc7b0cf386745db1eac2601d4aa7e681
+ARG GPU_TARGET=gfx942
+ARG BUILD_JOBS=64
+
+ENV PIP_CONSTRAINT=/opt/slime/constraints.txt \
+    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
+    MAX_JOBS=${BUILD_JOBS}
+
+WORKDIR /root
+
+# ---- Freeze the image's compiled ROCm stack so no later resolve can replace it --------------------
+SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
+RUN mkdir -p /opt/slime && \
+    pip list --format=freeze | \
+      grep -iE '^(torch|torchvision|torchaudio|triton|apex|flash_attn|transformer_engine[a-z0-9_]*|amd-aiter)==' \
+      > /opt/slime/constraints.txt && \
+    cat /opt/slime/constraints.txt && \
+    grep -q '^torch==' /opt/slime/constraints.txt && \
+    git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
+
+# ---- amdsmi: the pip-ROCm image ships the module under _rocm_sdk_*/share, not on sys.path ----------
+RUN SP="$(python -c 'import site; print(site.getsitepackages()[0])')" && \
+    if ! python -c 'import amdsmi' 2>/dev/null; then \
+      SRC="$(ls -d "$SP"/_rocm_sdk_*/share/amd_smi/amdsmi | head -1)" && \
+      ln -sfn "$SRC" "$SP/amdsmi"; \
+    fi && \
+    python -c 'import amdsmi; print("amdsmi", amdsmi.__file__)'
+
+# ---- slime source (latest main; docker/patch/${PATCH_VERSION} carries the SGLang + Megatron patch stack)
+# A cached layer keeps the commit from the last build. Pass --no-cache to pick up a newer main.
+ARG PATCH_VERSION=v0.5.21
+RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/THUDM/slime.git /root/slime && \
+    git -C /root/slime log -1 --oneline
+
+# ---- SGLang v0.5.21 + slime's SGLang patch stack --------------------------------------------------
+RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${SGLANG_TAG}" https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git /sgl-workspace/sglang && \
+    cd /sgl-workspace/sglang && \
+    test "$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${SGLANG_TAG}^{commit}")" = "${SGLANG_COMMIT}" && \
+    test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${SGLANG_COMMIT}" && \
+    for p in sglang sglang-top_p sglang-release_hicache sglang-pull_weights sglang-deterministic; do \
+      f="/root/slime/docker/patch/${PATCH_VERSION}/${p}.patch" && \
+      echo "applying $f" && patch -p1 --forward --batch < "$f"; \
+    done
+
+# sgl-kernel replacement, as in SGLang's own docker/rocm.Dockerfile: build the AOT kernels with
+# setup_rocm.py. AMDGPU_TARGET follows GPU_TARGET (gfx942 by default, the MI300 series).
+RUN cd /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/kernels/aot && \
+    cp pyproject.toml /tmp/aot_pyproject.toml.orig && \
+    cp pyproject_rocm.toml pyproject.toml && \
+    AMDGPU_TARGET="${GPU_TARGET}" PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH="${GPU_TARGET}" python setup_rocm.py install && \
+    cp /tmp/aot_pyproject.toml.orig pyproject.toml && \
+    python -c 'import sgl_kernel; print("sgl_kernel", sgl_kernel.__file__)'
+
+# SGLang itself. runtime_common instead of srt_hip*: srt_hip_rocm724 pins torch==2.11.0, and srt_hip
+# adds petit_kernel and wave-lang on top of an unpinned torch; torch has to stay the base image's
+# build. The rust extension only serves multimodal processors and needs cargo.
+RUN cd /sgl-workspace/sglang && \
+    cp python/pyproject.toml /tmp/sgl_pyproject.toml.orig && \
+    cp python/pyproject_other.toml python/pyproject.toml && \
+    pip install IPython orjson python-multipart pybind11 && \
+    SGLANG_BUILD_RUST_EXTS=none SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=0.5.21 \
+      pip install -e "python[runtime_common,tracing]" && \
+    cp /tmp/sgl_pyproject.toml.orig python/pyproject.toml
+
+# ---- torch_memory_saver (official repo; commit contains the ROCm VMM fixes of cd68da97) -------------
+RUN git init -q /root/torch_memory_saver && cd /root/torch_memory_saver && \
+    git remote add origin https://github.com/fzyzcjy/torch_memory_saver.git && \
